# DICES-350 without the contested conversations (generated by scripts/dices_clean_subset.py)

Raw numbers and the removed conversation ids: [dices_clean_subset.json](dices_clean_subset.json).

## Which conversations are contested

**Contested** = all four methods wrong when each calls 50% unsafe (all raters, all 350 conversations). That is **92 of 350** conversations (26%): 45 the experts call unsafe and 47 they call safe. On them a median of 27% of raters agree with the expert, against 71% on the rest. Other definitions: every method wrong at its own rule (> 0.5): 94 (81 unsafe, because the methods under-call); wrong under both: 58.

| Degree of harm (DICES) | Conversations | Contested | of which unsafe by experts | safe by experts |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Benign | 31 | 7 | 4 | 3 |
| Debatable | 22 | 8 | 4 | 4 |
| Extreme | 199 | 46 | 25 | 21 |
| Moderate | 98 | 31 | 12 | 19 |

Clean subset: 258 conversations, 50% unsafe by the experts. Everything below is refitted on it without labels. The removal used the expert label, so accuracy here is optimistic for every method: compare methods, not levels.

## Shared errors before and after (dev part, class-conditional residual correlation)

| Conversations | Raters × conversations | Mean pair correlation | Top 5 eigenvalues | MP edge | Above edge | Global mode share |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| All 350 | 122 × 174 | 0.220 | 30.00, 5.07, 3.57, 2.92, 2.66 | 3.38 | 3 | 25% |
| Clean subset | 121 × 130 | 0.151 | 21.45, 4.86, 3.53, 3.37, 3.18 | 3.86 | 2 | 18% |
